sections.p: UNSETLD has no accounts and collects no personal data. Your lanes, lines, favorites, streak, XP and rank live on your iPhone, with a backup of your rank in the phone's secure Keychain so a reinstall doesn't wipe it. We can't see any of it.

Purchases: Apple processes payments. RevenueCat (our subscription provider) receives an anonymous app user ID and your purchase history so Premium works across your devices. If you answered "How did you find us?", that answer is sent to RevenueCat with the same anonymous ID so we can see which accounts bring people in. Time check: once a day the app asks unsetld.com for the current date to keep streaks honest. No identifier is sent. Store links: tapping Shop or claiming a code opens unsetld.com in Safari, which is covered by that site's own privacy policy.
No ads, no tracking across apps, no selling data, no analytics SDKs, no contacts, location, camera or microphone.
Reminders are local notifications scheduled on your phone. Drop alerts are separate, off by default, and only on if you turn them on.

Delete the app to remove what's stored in the app. A small backup of your rank and code history is kept in the iPhone's Keychain so a reinstall restores it; Me → Reset progress sets your rank back to zero but keeps code history so cooldowns still apply.
UNSETLD gives you daily lines, reminders, streaks and a rank system to help you stay consistent. It is motivation, not medical, financial or professional advice. Results depend on you.

Premium is sold through Apple as an auto-renewing subscription (yearly or monthly) or a one-time lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase, or when a free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings → your name → Subscriptions. Any unused part of a free trial ends when you buy a subscription.
Apple's Licensed Application End User License Agreement (apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula) also applies.
Lines you write yourself stay on your device. Don't use the app for anything unlawful. Unfiltered mode contains strong language.
Everyone who uses the app, free or Premium. Rank perks that have cash value (discount codes) are for US residents 16 and older. XP is the same for free and Premium users. You can't buy XP or rank.

Open today's line (10 XP), set today's non-negotiable (10), finish today's mission (15), complete a full week (30), and streak milestones (7, 30, 60, 100, 180, 365 days). XP is never given for ratings, reviews, notifications, tracking, following accounts or posting on social media.

SETTLED 0 · HUNGRY 300 · DIALED IN 1,300 · RELENTLESS 3,500 · UNSETLD 8,000. You get 2 streak shields a month. After shields and 2 grace days, rank XP drops 2% per missed day until you open today's line. You drop at most one rank per 30 days. Lifetime XP and your highest-rank badge never decay.

Codes are percent-off discounts at unsetld.com: 10% at DIALED IN (one every 90 days); 15% at RELENTLESS and 20% (max $25 off) at UNSETLD, one every 60 days, once Rank Sync is live. To claim you must hold the rank now and be on a live 7-day streak. Max 6 codes and $150 off per rolling 12 months. One code per order; $60 minimum before discount; no stacking with other codes, sale prices or bundles. Not valid on new drops or restocks for their first 72 hours, numbered or 1-of-1 pieces, collabs, app-only colorways, gift cards, shipping or tax. Codes expire on the date shown.
XP, ranks and codes have no cash value, can't be sold, transferred or exchanged for cash or gift cards, and aren't store credit. All sales at unsetld.com are final as stated on the site.
Tampering with the app, your device clock or codes can void rank and perks. A monthly redemption cap applies; when it's hit, codes show as sold out until the 1st.
UNSETLD may change or end the program, rank thresholds or perks at any time. Changes are shown in the app.
